# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Image comparison and rendering fixes**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.159.0 adds experimental image comparison tools and corrects runtime-effect uniform initialization. The upcoming release also improves Ganesh texture-edge sampling and changes Tizen's CPU blur selection. Linux x86 native assets are no longer packaged.

## Breaking Changes

- **Move away from Linux x86 native assets** — Linux x86 native builds and NuGet package entries have been removed. Applications relying on those assets must move to a supported Linux architecture before upgrading. ([#5784](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5784))

## API Surface

- **Experimental image comparison package** — SkiaSharp.Testing adds SKImageComparison for images, bitmaps and pixmaps, with channel tolerances, masks, mismatch budgets, error metrics and difference images. The separately packaged assembly is experimental; opt in by suppressing diagnostic SKIA4001 with NoWarn or a pragma. ([#5293](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5293))

## Bug Fixes

- **Predictable runtime-effect uniforms** — New SKRuntimeEffectUniforms buffers start zeroed. Reset() clears the existing buffer in place rather than allocating a replacement, including when uniforms are reused for meshes. — ❤️ [@taublast](https://github.com/taublast) ([#5843](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5843))
- **Safer Ganesh texture-edge sampling** — Linear filtering clamps inward to avoid sampling undefined texels outside texture subsets. This affects Ganesh, not CPU or Graphite rendering; texture-edge pixels may differ. ([#5679](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5679))
- **Tizen CPU blur selection aligned** — Tizen now applies its blur configuration to Skia itself, selecting the existing ThreeBoxApprox/Tent paths instead of the shader-based Gaussian candidate. Blur pixels and performance may differ; Tizen rendering and performance were not measured in the reported validation. ([#5679](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5679))
